case.summary: The evidence shows a card-not-present online purchase that the customer says they did not make. The transaction is not a tiny probe authorization and there is no card-present travel pattern or other sign of out-of-region use; instead, the strongest signals are the online channel, the match-flag anomalies, and the customer report. The amount is also consistent with prior charges on this card, so this is not a card-testing sequence, but the overall record still fits card-not-present fraud more than legitimate activity.
